description: Get Google Trends search interest for any keyword over time, for one country or worldwide, as JSON. See whether demand is rising, falling or just seasonal. Use it when: You need to know whether interest in a topic is rising, falling or seasonal. Not for: Absolute search volumes; Google Trends gives relative interest from 0 to 100. Returns: A dated series of 0–100 interest values for the keyword, timeframe and country, plus a link to the chart. Typical time: about 7 s. Price: $0.037 per report, charged only on success. One call = one Google Trends report.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, uppercase, e.g. US, GB, DE; leave out for worldwide

keyword.description: One keyword or phrase, e.g. ai agents

name: search-trends
title: Google Trends interest
